copy.speaker: Caption
copy.text: Next morning. Tenth round complete.

copy.speaker: Ossa
copy.text: They will still be there when you have put your money away.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: I have the request. I still do not know the door.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Then we look before we promise.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: Stay on the dry side, please.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: You asked about first-bell collection. This is Aren, and Sera came to see the approach.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: First bell is when this doorway is clear.

copy.speaker: Caption
copy.text: Second bell.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: The tubs keep moving through second bell. I cannot stop the wash floor for a cart.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: First bell is my Lower Post round. I cannot take that time.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: Then why did you come?

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Because we had not looked at the door.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: Good. Look before you quote me.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: These are ours. Two small bundles, dry and tied. We can try with them.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: The wheel stays out. That sill has a job.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I can carry one through by hand.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: We should see whether the doorway stays clear while you do.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: One out-and-back trial, as far as the trough. Both bundles come back to this bench.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: I will pay each of you for the trial, even if we stop at the door.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: I can do one trial now. The packing yard has me after third bell.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: If the route does not work, we bring it back.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Use the morning as it is. Do not clear it for us.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Wait. I am taking your doorway.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: That is what I meant by first bell.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: You needed the doorway back. Not an earlier cart.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: Does that one open onto the dry bench?

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: We use it for mending. A collection basket will not fit.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: These wraps will. The cart stays out here.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: If the wash floor keeps moving, I do not need you at first bell.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: Beside the first. Keep the handle side clear.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: Enough room to stop and let someone past.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: Dry. Both back. And the floor never stopped.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: Use this hatch when we agree a collection. Do not leave a stack outside for me to find.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: After the post, between second and third bell. Only small, dry bundles like these.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: And I hand them over. Nothing waiting in the street.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: Ask where the load is going before you put my cart in the plan.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Door, load and your hours. Then a price.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Dry hatch. Two bundles. One forecourt trial.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: That is what we have seen.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: For your time. The stopped attempt counted too.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: And yours.

copy.speaker: Edda
copy.text: Next time, knock here before you bring anything.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: We will ask about the load first.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I nearly said first bell just to keep her listening.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: She listened when you stopped guessing about her morning.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: I have my next job. Ask me before you accept the next load.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I will.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I want to know which part I am ready for.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Then that is the question we take.
